title: the question set
description: User story under REQ-186. computeQuestions turns every failing product-owner item into one plain question with its write-back, so the harness can ask without reading gate internals.
iWant: computeQuestions to turn every failing product-owner item into one plain question with its write-back
soThat: I can ask without reading gate internals

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given a tree where brief:openQuestions, skeleton:resolvedBy and stories:reqHasUs each fail at least one item, when computeQuestions runs with persona productOwner, then questions[] holds exactly one entry per failing item with id, stage, check, itemId, heading, ask, answerKinds, writeBack and blocks intent.
[happy] given the same tree, when computeQuestions runs twice, then the two questions[] arrays are deep-equal and ordered D1, D2, D4, D7 then by source span.
[happy] given an open decision with two options and a default, when computeQuestions runs, then it appears in optional[] with blocks build and not in questions[].
[happy] given a tree where levels.intentComplete.ok is true, when computeQuestions runs with persona productOwner, then questions[] is empty and ok is true.
[happy] given persona engineer, when computeQuestions runs, then questions[] holds one entry per failing engineer item in failing stages and blocks is build.
[failure] given a persona value outside productOwner and engineer, when computeQuestions runs, then it throws a usage error naming the accepted values.
[must-not] given any tree, when computeQuestions runs, then no file under rcf/ is created or modified and no question carries a writeBack command whose verb is not registered in the CLI help.
